facts.fact: Luminate says Nigeria began developing a National Artificial Intelligence Strategy through a week-long workshop of over 100 Nigerian experts, with the Minister of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy announcing the AI Collective at its close.

systems.owner: Data Science Nigeria, Lagos Business School, CJID; housed in NCAIR

NGA.note: Nothing stated on AI models, datasets or computing built in the country.

facts.fact: Luminate says the AI Collective, run by Data Science Nigeria, Lagos Business School and the Centre for Journalism, Innovation and Development, covers governance, research and innovation, with CJID coordinating AI governance work and LBS leading knowledge building and the National AI Research Scheme.
The AI Collective of local institutions is described as charged with supporting development of Nigeria's national AI strategy, with LBS saying it will support evidence-based AI policies.

NGA.note: The strategy workshop is not said to include people outside government.
No startup law, label or public fund stated; the funding is Luminate's, a private donor.

facts.fact: Luminate calls Data Science Nigeria the first dedicated AI start-up incubation hub in Nigeria, spearheading initiatives for entrepreneurship and a platform for start-ups; no programme cohort is described.
